A.description: Structural governed retrieval with deterministic evidence rendering only.

B.description: Condition A plus authorized semantic HITL knowledge; deterministic evidence rendering when no exact deterministic answer exists.

C.description: Condition B plus grounded LLM writer for open questions when governed evidence is sufficient.

invariants: PostgreSQL remains authority in all conditions.
Ambiguity, mutative-action policy, clarification and abstention remain deterministic in all conditions.
A/B never call the answer writer.
A never queries or authorizes semantic Chroma knowledge.
Graph OFF never executes Neo4j traversal.
Condition C does not force the LLM over exact deterministic answers; the writer is used only on the GROUNDED_LLM path.
reopen_policy: Reopen only for a demonstrated blocking experimental-control defect before the global development freeze.

graph_enabled.off: Neo4j expansion disabled after the governed traversal plan is computed; canonical and dense retrieval remain available.
